page: Amazon Web Services c8gd.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor system. It is powered by the arm64 AWS Graviton processor family, utilizing the ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 architecture running at a base clock speed of 2.8 GHz. The instance is configured with 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs, assigning one thread per core without simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation is set at 96.0 GB, providing a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware cache structures include 64 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 36 MB of shared L3 cache. Cryptographic processing is accelerated via dedicated hardware AES instructions.

Integrated directly into the instance is 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, eliminating network storage overhead for high-throughput operations. Network performance is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 22 Gbps. The architecture contains no dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. Compute and memory testing demonstrates high throughput across parallel tasks, with Geekbench multi-core testing scoring 23361.0 and clang compilation benchmarking reaching 69900.0. Uncached memory operations achieve 381.77 GB/sec for sequential reads and 181.15 GB/sec for sequential writes. Synthetic multi-core stress testing registers 81873.9 under stress-ng, while single-core compute performance remains average across standard suites.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio combined with dedicated single-threaded physical cores offers high efficiency for parallel CPU workloads without the performance variance of multi-threaded contention. The presence of dense local NVMe storage and high memory bandwidth makes the c8gd.12xlarge well matched for large-scale software compilation, continuous integration pipelines, batch analytics, Redis caching clusters, high-throughput static web serving, and database engines requiring low-latency scratch space.
description: Amazon Web Services c8gd.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance based on the AWS Nitro System and powered by the 64-bit ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 Graviton architecture. It features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs operating at 2.8 GHz, alongside 96.0 GB of system memory, matching a 1:2 memory-to-core ratio. The instance includes 2850 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and provides a baseline network throughput of 22 Gbps, with zero GPU accelerators attached. In synthetic and application benchmarks, the platform demonstrates top-tier multi-core execution, clang compilation throughput, and memory bandwidth, reaching 381.77 GB/sec on uncached reads. Single-thread performance occupies a standard tier. This hardware configuration is suited for highly concurrent CPU workloads, Clang/GCC build farms, high-throughput web serving, distributed caching, and database workloads requiring dedicated high-speed local disk capacity.
